units.source_text: 近卫府派来司祭的敕使，是头中将柏木。

en.t: The imperial messenger sent by the Palace Guards for the festival was Kashiwagi, the Captain Secretary.

units.source_text: 他从父亲内大臣邸内出发，王侯公卿等跟他同行，一齐来到源氏大臣的看台上。

en.t: He set out from his father the Minister of the Center's mansion, accompanied by princes and court nobles, and they all came together to Minister Genji's viewing stand.

units.source_text: 惟光的女儿藤典侍也是司祭敕使。

en.t: Koremitsu's daughter, the Fuji Naishi no Suke, was also an imperial messenger serving at the festival.

units.source_text: 此人声望甚高，自冷泉帝、皇太子以至源氏太政大臣，都犒赏她无数珍贵物品，圣眷十分优厚。

en.t: Her reputation was very high, and from Emperor Reizei and the Crown Prince to the Grand Minister Genji, all bestowed countless precious gifts on her, showing her exceptional imperial favor.

units.source_text: 她出发之时，夕雾中将还写信给她。

en.t: When she was about to depart, Lieutenant General Yugiri also wrote her a letter.

units.source_text: 她与夕雾有情，虽不公开，而交谊甚厚。

en.t: She and Yugiri were romantically attached; though their bond was not public, their intimacy was very deep.

units.source_text: 夕雾与身份高贵的云居雁成亲，藤典侍闻之异常伤心。

en.t: When Yugiri married the highborn Kumoi no Kari, the Fuji Naishi no Suke heard of it and was deeply heartbroken.
